steps.en: Notices of local NRIC holders are picked for a check
steps.id: Notice pemegang NRIC lokal dipilih untuk dicek

steps.en: Notices of FIN holders are picked for a check
steps.id: Notice pemegang FIN dipilih untuk dicek
steps.why_en: The selection job is switched off in the live environment.
steps.why_id: Job pemilihan dimatikan di lingkungan live.

steps.en: NRIC numbers are sent to the immigration authority
steps.id: Nomor NRIC dikirim ke otoritas imigrasi
steps.why_en: Sending works, but an open live defect lets unread files pile up and get rejected.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman jalan, tetapi ada defect live yang belum ditutup: file menumpuk dan ditolak.

steps.en: FIN numbers are sent to the immigration and manpower data sources
steps.id: Nomor FIN dikirim ke sumber data imigrasi dan tenaga kerja
steps.why_en: Built, but the job is off live and the live data views are unverified.
steps.why_id: Sudah dibuat, tetapi job mati di live dan view data live belum diverifikasi.

steps.en: Passport numbers are sent to the authorities for a check
steps.id: Nomor passport dikirim ke otoritas untuk dicek
steps.why_en: Passport holders are never sent for a check.
steps.why_id: Pemegang passport tidak pernah dikirim untuk dicek.

steps.en: The latest home address of NRIC holders is saved on the notice
steps.id: Alamat rumah terbaru pemegang NRIC disimpan di notice
steps.why_en: Logic exists, but a live defect reports results not saved while reports said success.
steps.why_id: Logic ada, tetapi defect live melaporkan hasil tidak tersimpan padahal report sukses.

steps.en: The latest home address of FIN holders is saved on the notice
steps.id: Alamat rumah terbaru pemegang FIN disimpan di notice
steps.why_en: Only work-pass and pass holders get an address; the job is off live.
steps.why_id: Hanya pemegang work pass dan pass yang dapat alamat; job mati di live.

steps.en: A deceased status from the authorities is saved for the offender
steps.id: Status meninggal dari otoritas disimpan untuk offender
steps.why_en: Works for NRIC, but shares the open live defect; the FIN path is off live.
steps.why_id: Jalan untuk NRIC, tetapi ikut defect live yang belum ditutup; jalur FIN mati di live.

steps.en: A change in citizenship status is received from the authorities
steps.id: Perubahan status kewarganegaraan diterima dari otoritas
steps.why_en: Only FIN to PR/citizen is caught, not NRIC holders; the job is off live.
steps.why_id: Hanya FIN ke PR/warga negara yang tertangkap, bukan pemegang NRIC; job mati di live.
